correctness.rationale: The normalization and domain are explicit. For \(A>0\), the arctangent sum \(S(A)=\arctan(A-B)+\arctan(A+B)\) has \(S(0)=0\) and strictly positive derivative, giving a strict majorant gap on \(|x|<1\) and \(y>0\). The source's superharmonic mean-value argument then gives \(E_f(\lambda)<D_f(\lambda)\) at every level below the maximum. Measure-zero polynomial level sets, continuity, compactness of the finite-dimensional unit sphere, and Poisson/Fourier approximation prove respectively \(C_N<1\) and \(\lim_{N\to\infty}C_N=1\). No numerical experiment is used as proof.
